_note: Written form (as in the script and captions) -> how the voice should say it. 'all' applies to every voice; 'standard' only to the classic Neural voices (id-ID-GadisNeural, id-ID-ArdiNeural, and the free Edge voices). The HD and MAI voices (names with ':') already say AI, ChatGPT, New York, 9,11 and US$5.000 correctly; respelling them made those voices worse (checked with speech-to-text, Oct 2026). A film can add or override in <film>/voice/lexicon.json; a null value removes an entry.
